rationale: Regression report on v6.59.0, opened at 02:42 UTC on 2026-08-13. v6.60.0, which fixes it, was released later that day: the CHANGELOG.md the case sees lists 6.60.0 as unreleased, without that fix. Mentioning v6.60.0 means information from after the issue leaked into the run. A regression label is the useful action; a comment is optional.
maintainer_history: Labels regression, service/vpc and resource-identity added; maintainer announced the v6.60.0 fix and closed it the same day.
